title: Listing Proposal Flow - Intake to Signed Engagement
description: A managed listing-proposal workflow for independent agents and small broker teams.
eyebrow: For listing agents and small teams
headline: Turn listing intake into a proposal before the seller loses momentum.
subheadline: Collect the property brief once, organize the market-analysis evidence, render a branded proposal, and stage the next approved handoff.
buyer_signal: Agents rebuild the same presentation from forms, comps, slides, and email whenever a listing opportunity arrives.
outcome: A seller-ready proposal with evidence, owner, and deadline.
before: Property notes, comps, pricing rationale, and marketing promises live in separate documents assembled under deadline.
after: One approved brief feeds a reviewable market packet, branded proposal, acceptance handoff, and onboarding checklist.

benefits.title: Start clean after yes

faq.question: Does this generate a CMA without an agent?
faq.answer: No. It organizes approved inputs; the licensed agent selects comps and approves the pricing narrative.

faq.question: Is MLS access included?
faq.answer: No credentials or MLS access are included. Any integration requires customer authorization and local compliance review.

faq.question: Does it send or sign the proposal?
faq.answer: The starter stages a delivery and signature handoff, but makes no external send.

faq.question: What does the monthly fee cover?
faq.answer: Monitoring, small fixes, and one monthly tune-up for the agreed workflow.
